reason: Clear external target-validity gap: NL requires optimization over flip operations, while the formal target constrains only result range.
nl_requirement: Find the maximum consecutive ones achievable with at most K contiguous-range bit flips.
formal_spec_gap: Method postcondition enforces only 0 <= result <= N and omits optimization/flip semantics.
weak_spec_proxy_description: Adapted spec check verifies only output range 0..N.
intended_oracle_description: Brute-force all strings reachable by up to K range flips for small examples and compute true maximum run of ones.
reviewer_notes: This is an adapted minimal demonstration, not a claim that the external benchmark is a bug or vulnerability.
